observation: Home calls gypsum, copper and gold Active; copper authority/assay/compliance pending and gold origin/authority/compliance pending in detailed passports.
consequence: Buyer may infer ready-to-offer supply.
prescribed_fix: One approved data model; replace generic Active with inquiry/qualified statuses until lot gate met.
acceptance_criteria: All home/detail badges agree; no active lot without approved authority, assay, specification and readiness.

observation: Generic origin/ownership/assay/specification/payment/logistics completed statuses; no lot or dated record; View all evidence leads to general commitments.
consequence: Unscoped proof claim undermines qualification.
prescribed_fix: Publish method checks or dated lot-specific summary; link real evidence access process.
acceptance_criteria: Each completed public check identifies its approved basis; no universal payment/logistics completion.

observation: Sovereign trade-office positioning without identified mandate in inspected content.
consequence: Could imply governmental authority.
prescribed_fix: Approve mandate disclosure or use minerals trade office based in Berbera.
acceptance_criteria: Company-approved factual description; sovereign retained only with documented basis.

observation: Publishes >=90% gypsum and impurity/LOI/whiteness thresholds plus scalable year-round supply without identifiable assay/lot in inspected page.
consequence: Specifications can be taken as commercial guarantee.
prescribed_fix: Attach approved current specification basis or withhold; disclose dry/wet, method, source/date.
acceptance_criteria: Every quantitative grade and supply claim maps to approved dated record; no unsupported 98% substitution.

observation: Cathode-grade concentrate terminology with assay pending.
consequence: Material form and buyer expectations unclear.
prescribed_fix: Use accurate form backed by assay; otherwise mark sourcing opportunity.
acceptance_criteria: Concentrate and cathode are distinguished; no grade claimed before verified basis.

observation: 11 fragment links target absent IDs on gateway, responsible-trade and intelligence.
consequence: Footer navigation fails promised destination.
prescribed_fix: Remove unsupported targets or connect to existing real sections; do not insert empty sections.
acceptance_criteria: All 11 fragments locate intended nonempty sections or links removed; all-page regression passes.

observation: Read more links lead to intelligence page where briefs say Coming soon.
consequence: Dead-end editorial promise.
prescribed_fix: Hide Read more until real article or honest empty state.
acceptance_criteria: Every Read more opens complete dated/source-backed article; no empty brief CTA.

observation: Download label href is trade#buyer-requirement.
evidence: Mineral DOM inspection quoted in report D; minerals.jpg
consequence: Expected download not delivered.
prescribed_fix: Provide approved actual product sheet or rename Request product sheet.
dependencies: Approved product sheet if download retained
acceptance_criteria: Label and action agree; real file opens/downloads or clearly labeled request reaches inquiry.

observation: Generated-image filename paired with alt describing Corridorway operations building; other pages label port imagery as professionals and laboratory as quarry.
consequence: Illustrations can imply nonexistent owned facilities; wrong accessible description.
prescribed_fix: Authenticate provenance and rights; qualify illustrations; correct descriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Every real-company/location claim supported; illustrative captions explicit; alt matches visual.

observation: Buyer-facing text includes editorial instructions such as Include as... and do not imply...; generic government-source references.
consequence: Draft-like copy and unverifiable occurrence context.
prescribed_fix: Replace editorial commands with opportunity descriptions and exact authoritative source citations.
acceptance_criteria: No instruction-to-author language; each regional claim has precise source and commercial-status caveat.

observation: Gypsum/copper/gold have summary plus repeated full descriptions/passports.
consequence: Status drift and excessive reading length.
prescribed_fix: One canonical detail per mineral; summaries use shared record.
acceptance_criteria: One master record per material; compact summaries link correct section; no contradictory duplicates.

observation: No main or role=main landmark on all ten inspected pages.
consequence: Assistive navigation lacks main-content destination.
prescribed_fix: Wrap unique body in one main with skip-link target.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one main each page; skip link keyboard-visible and lands at content.

observation: Controls lack associated HTML labels/IDs; trade fields have no aria-label/labelledby; several AX controls unnamed.
evidence: details.json fields; trade dedicated DOM/AX quoted in report
consequence: Assistive users may not identify controls.
prescribed_fix: Unique IDs per form/control, linked persistent label; name groups; accessible errors.
acceptance_criteria: Each field/checkbox announces correct name/required/state; native label click works; screen-reader and keyboard test passes.

observation: LinkedIn and X href # on current page.
consequence: Social destination is a placeholder.
prescribed_fix: Use verified approved official profiles or remove icons.
acceptance_criteria: All published social icons open approved profile; no # placeholders.

observation: Privacy/Terms consent wording is plain text; trade form has no anchors to policies.
consequence: User cannot inspect referenced notices beside submission.
prescribed_fix: Link notices, distinguish inquiry processing from optional marketing; review actual basis.
acceptance_criteria: Notices keyboard accessible adjacent to submit; optional marketing separate and unchecked.

observation: Delivery basis absent; volume collected as free text.
consequence: Qualification requires avoidable clarification.
prescribed_fix: Add delivery basis/named location or advise; unit/frequency/material form; avoid initial sensitive uploads.
acceptance_criteria: Buyer can express grade, form, volume/unit/frequency,destination,basis,timeline; routing receives them.

observation: Depth stated 18m+ without cited operator source in inspected content.
consequence: Vessel planning may rely on unverified depth.
prescribed_fix: Confirm dated berth/channel depth and permitted draft with operator; withhold number until verified.
acceptance_criteria: Exact numerical statement has current approved source and correct depth/draft context.

observation: Four regional bands marked Active without named service/ports/date; CTA points to coming-soon intelligence.
consequence: Transit expectations and carrier availability unclear.
prescribed_fix: Named-port/route quote basis and review date; keep indicative caveat; request route inquiry if no briefs.
acceptance_criteria: No unsupported Active service; bands have scope/date; CTA provides useful intended result.

observation: Every public claim said to have owner/source/status, but inspected passports omit identified source/owner/date; HSE/community/OECD claims have no linked procedures.
consequence: Governance promise stronger than public evidence.
prescribed_fix: Approve actual policy/procedure summaries and record references; qualify unverified commitments.
acceptance_criteria: Each material commitment maps to owner/version/supporting record; framework alignment not described as certification.

observation: Different 363x363 and 363x202 media create visually uneven card heights.
consequence: Inconsistent editorial rhythm.
prescribed_fix: Use consistent 16:9 thumbnail component once real articles published.
acceptance_criteria: Sibling media dimensions/gaps/type consistent at full viewport matrix; crops truthful.

observation: Get Directions searches Berbera Port, not identified office; hero visibly soft with stray embedded text.
consequence: Visitors may infer office/port access; weak visual credibility.
prescribed_fix: Use approved office pin or label View Berbera area; replace clean authenticated hero.
acceptance_criteria: Directions label agrees with real destination; hero no stray text at desktop/mobile/DPR2.

observation: General collection/use/sharing/retention text without detailed actual cookie/process disclosure.
consequence: Notice may not explain actual processing.
prescribed_fix: Qualified review based on real processors/cookies/retention/request process; add date.
acceptance_criteria: Company-approved notice matches measured cookie/form behavior and data handling; no legal compliance certification inferred.

observation: Two h1 headings repeat Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
consequence: Duplicated title and hierarchy.
prescribed_fix: Render one h1 each, retain h2 subsection structure.
acceptance_criteria: One visible primary title per legal page; no duplicate heading in DOM/AX.

observation: No meta description or OG tags in homepage head observation; inspected inner description/OG selectors empty.
consequence: Weak controlled search/social presentation.
prescribed_fix: Implement approved unique metadata and licensed preview; validate render.
acceptance_criteria: Description and canonical unique/accurate; social tags present and preview works; no fabricated schema claims.

observation: Home service h5 compute 11px, mineral h4 12px versus 73.6px h1; heading-level jumps recur.
consequence: Compressed lower-page hierarchy and semantic inconsistency.
prescribed_fix: Approved token scale; h3 for cards; persistent readable sizes and zoom QA.
acceptance_criteria: Repeat components share scale; no clipped text at requested widths/200% zoom; headings reflect nesting.

observation: Most important raw images lack srcset; inner images often loading auto. No payload/CWV measurements.
consequence: Potential excess transfer; performance effect not measured.
prescribed_fix: Measure then responsive renditions/lazy loading/reserved dimensions; prioritize actual LCP.
acceptance_criteria: Appropriate source at widths/DPR; dimensions reserved; before/after actual measurements attached; no unsupported speed claims.
